literal: Having embraced, without releasing, within the sulking, appears my heart-breaking weapon.
translation: Within the very sulking that persists even as we embrace without letting go, there appears the weapon that breaks my heart.
modern: தழுவிக்கொண்டு விடாமல் இருக்கும் ஊடலின் உள்ளே, எனது நெஞ்சத்தை உடைக்கின்ற ஆயுதம் தோன்றும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the intense emotional power of a lover's feigned anger or sulking (pulavi). Even when the lovers are in a tight embrace without letting go, a subtle sulking can still linger or arise within that intimacy. The speaker expresses that this persistent sulking acts like a sharp weapon, capable of breaking their heart. It beautifully illustrates how emotional vulnerability remains high even during physical closeness.
